# Native fixtures

Unmodified manufacturer PDFs exported from installed GRD 10.0.2 through this
adapter on 2026-11-14. Synthetic tool acceptance conditions, no project/customer
data. Model 1400, 8-inch neck, 24x24 module, F23 T-Bar, Horizontal, 50 fpm.
300 CFM and 112 CFM exercise high/low results and the native low-NC presentation
discrepancy. Tests parse real Crystal Reports output; fixtures are not simulated
calculations and do not replace live desktop acceptance.
